name: Planning with Learned Binarized Neural Networks (MaxSAT Evaluation 2021 benchmarks)
description: This document provides a brief introduction to learned automated planning problem where the state transition function is in the form of a binarized neural network (BNN), presents a general MaxSAT encoding for this problem, and describes the four domains, namely: Navigation, Inventory Control, System Administrator and Cellda, that are submitted as benchmarks for MaxSAT Evaluation 2021.
reputation: A specialized set of benchmarks submitted to the MaxSAT Evaluation 2021, used by the MaxSAT and planning research community for solver and encoding comparisons.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark focused on combinatorial/MaxSAT solvers; small and domain-specific set of instances derived from learned BNN transition models; requires MaxSAT solver tooling and careful encoding comparisons.
